title: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet, when the file is…
description: A vulnerability in LibreOffice allows it to open web query files (.iqy) that specify a web page to import into a spreadsheet. When such a file is opened via the command line, LibreOffice previously did not apply the same address validation checks as it does for direct command line addresses. This flaw could allow a crafted .iqy file to cause LibreOffice to perform unintended actions, including potentially executing code. The issue is addressed in fixed versions by restricting accepted addresses in .iqy files to only http or https URLs.
